answer: Counterparty diversity threshold blocks sybil swarms that only trade among themselves. Each identity must bridge to 12 counterparties, no partner above 25% of its volume. A cluster trading only inside its own circle finds no harbor and its rewards are withheld. Forging 100 fake identities needs 100 x 12 = 1,200 counterparties, so the attacker pays for every fake. An honest agent pays once, while a ring faking diversity spirals its cost upward.
